    app.windows(random_var_w=0.0, window_1=[420, 780], window_2=[825, 1230])

    app.specific_cycle(2, p_21=7500, t_21=7, p_22=6.0, t_22=25, r_c2=0, cw21=[420, 690], cw22=[1140, 1230])
    app.specific_cycle(3, p_31=7500, t_31=10, p_32=6.0, t_32=2, r_c3=0, cw31=[690, 735], cw32=[1050, 1140])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # profil moyen de 480 jours simules ; moteur RAMP du depot DBSCAN-RAMP-PUE-V4

    sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "DBSCAN-RAMP-PUE-V4"))
    from ramp import User, UseCase
    uc = UseCase(name="pue", date_start="2024-01-01", date_end="2025-04-25")
